To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
polymer-based inactivated mucosal bivalent vaccine formulations for ND and H9N 2 viruses were prepared and evaluated in specific pathogen free (SPF) chickens.
polymer adjuvant is more effective than nanoparticles adjuvants when used via spray vaccination route in chickens.
mucosal vaccination with polymer and nanoparticles adjuvants is an efficient strategy to induce protection against Newcastle disease and H5N2 viruses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new mucosal inactivated vaccine formulations to protect against ND and AI viruses.
the development of new vaccines for the prevention of Newcastle disease and H5N1 influenza viruses in poultry.
the development of new vaccines against Newcastle disease and H7N9 influenza viruses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work has provided a new strategy to develop mucosal vaccines against Newcastle disease and H5N1 avian influenza viruses.
the spray route of administration of polymer-based inactivated vaccines for ND virus and Avain Influenza viruses is more effective than intranasal route of administration.
this study provides a new approach for the development of mucosal inactivated vaccine formulations that can be applied for vaccination of poultry against ND and H9N9 viruses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polymer based inactivated vaccine formulation for ND virus and H9N9 virus could be a promising vaccine for the prevention of these viruses.
the use of polymer adjuvantes is promising for mucosal vaccination of ND and H9N 2 viruses.
we developed an inactivated bivalent vaccine for ND and Avian Inﬂuenza H9N2 virus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of polymer adjuvantes via spray route of administration is a good strategy to improve mucosal immunity against Newcastle disease and H1N9 Avian influenza viruses.

the use of polymer and nanoparticles adjuvants in the spray route of delivery of inactivated bivalent vaccines for Newcastle disease and Avian influenza H9N2 virus induced a significant protection against challenge with the respective viruses.
the use of nanoparticles adjuvants via intranasal route of administration is not effective in inducing cell mediated immunity.
